item.title: CVE-2026-118180 — Matrix homeserver could redirect the chat session to a local file or network share
item.description: When logging in to a Matrix account, Thunderbird used the homeserver address provided in the server's login response without validating it. A malicious or compromised homeserver could provide a file: URL, causing Thunderbird to send all further Matri…

item.title: CVE-2026-118179 — Request forgery via news: links
item.description: Clicking a news: or snews: link that referenced a message-ID made Thunderbird connect, without asking, to the host and port given in the link, even if it was not a configured news server. Line breaks in the message-ID were sent to the server unmodifi…

item.title: CVE-2026-118178 — RSS feed could redirect its subscription to a local file or network share
item.description: A remote RSS feed could use the itunes:new-feed-url or newLocation element to permanently change its stored subscription URL to a file: URL. Thunderbird then read that location on every feed update. This allowed a malicious feed, or an attacker able…

item.title: CVE-2026-118177 — Calendar discovery accepted local file and remote network share locations
item.description: When looking for calendars in a directory on a server, during account setup or when adding a new network calendar, Thunderbird accepted calendar locations pointing to other servers, local files or network shares. A malicious server, or a network atta…

item.title: CVE-2026-118176 — Bypass of remote UNC path restriction in mailbox: URLs
item.description: Thunderbird's check that prevents mailbox: URLs from accessing files on remote Windows network shares could be bypassed using extended-length UNC paths. Displaying a specially crafted email could cause Thunderbird to connect to an SMB server chosen b…

item.title: CVE-2026-118175 — Content of other messages could be included when replying to a crafted message
item.description: When replying to, forwarding, or editing a crafted email message as new, Thunderbird could embed parts of a different message stored in the same folder into the message being composed, without showing a blocked content warning. If the user sent the m…

item.description: When a message containing an OpenPGP key attachment was displayed, Thunderbird automatically loaded the attachment's content to offer importing the key. A sender could mark the attachment as an external attachment pointing to an arbitrary URL, which…
